correctness.rationale: Exact primorial block translation preserves each residue once m divides P_n. Recurrence w_{n+1}=p_{n+1}w_n-s_{n+1} and a two-scale prefix discrepancy O(P_{n-1}+p_{n+1}^2) prove full natural-density existence. Dirichlet primes in each reduced class force every tail positive. The PNT gives adjacent prime gap/p ratio o(1), making primorial-scaled tails approach zero. Rationality would force these tails, multiplied by a fixed denominator, to be positive integers tending to zero. Boundaries n>=n0>=3 and unit squarefree m are explicit. Exact Python replay checks 90 finite recurrences; this is corroboration, not an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The original work explicitly studies density and distribution of records of a prime-driven permutation. Determining that every reduced squarefree residue class has a nonzero irrational natural density, including irrationality of the previously unknown global density constant, settles a natural qualitative invariant for infinitely many modular parameters. It is not a finite table, arbitrary slice, or mere numerical inequality; the proof uses the distinct arithmetic feature that infinitely many admissible primes keep the correction tail positive as prime gaps become negligible.
